faq_heading: Homes near Enver Creek Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Enver Creek Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Enver Creek Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Enver Creek Secondary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Enver Creek Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 165 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,300,000, townhomes $747,500, condos $488,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Enver Creek Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Enver Creek Secondary the median was 23 days on the market, closing at 96.2% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 165 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Enver Creek Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Janice Churchill Elementary (0.4 km south-east), Cornerstone Montessori School (0.4 km east) and Brookside Elementary (0.6 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Enver Creek Secondary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Enver Creek Secondary in a straight line (19 elementary, 8 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Janice Churchill Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Queen Elizabeth Secondary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is SAIL Secondary (1.8 km); the nearest independent school is Cornerstone Montessori School (0.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (2.2 km). Other secondary schools close by: SAIL Secondary (1.8 km north-west), SD 36 Education Services (Type 1) (1.8 km north-west), Surrey Academy of Innovative Learning (1.8 km north-west), Frank Hurt Secondary (1.9 km south-west), North Surrey Learning Centre (2.0 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Surrey Academy of Innovative Learning, 1.8 km north-west of Enver Creek Secondary.
